status: Partial Tuff Twins encounter and dependency correction; no full parity acceptance.

19.2.0.movement: Pair of six-part grounded worms roam cardinally, following head trails; speed increases as armor disappears.
19.2.0.targeting: Random roaming, not aimed pursuit. Child population checked across the whole room.
19.2.0.attacks: Armored heads spawn Ink; exposed heads spawn Suckers. No attempt at four living children, but a final burst can exceed four. Exposed bodies spray blood shots.
19.2.0.vulnerability: Separate 15 armor and source 35 flesh HP per part. Nonexplosive damage blocked by armor; explosions apply distance-dependent 25–14 percent damage before and after stripping. Plan C cannot bypass armor. Terra and item-created rock waves are named exceptions; Sulfuric Acid is not. Repentance+ Hagalaz excluded.
19.2.0.phases: New rear chains need more than two surviving parts; topology reconciles after each complete damage batch. Aggregate fight outlives either original head.
19.2.0.offspring: Two six-part worms, at least two Bomb Grimaces, Ink and Sucker children. Same source tuple represents each worm segment.
19.2.0.completion: Defeating one head does not finish the pair. All segments must die. Children remain ordinary threats.

adaptations.health: Source flesh 35 * 3.2 = 112 per segment; independent armor stays 15. No player-default change. Aggregate bar sums flesh HP over initial 1344; armor is visible on each part.
adaptations.damage: Linear interpolation between sourced explosive endpoints is local, as is no flesh spillover on the stripping hit. Explicit explosion provenance; generic area/piercing/execution flags cannot fake bombs. Cheat execution is separate.
adaptations.motion: Local 1.8 units/s, up to 80 percent exposed speed bonus, spacing 1.55, turn interval 1.2–3.4 s; path samples spaced 0.1 units, bounded 1024. Followers close gaps at up to 1.5 times head speed. Short rear fragments reattach without deleting HP/armor: unverified edge-case policy.
adaptations.attacks: Local 5 s head interval, 1–2 children per burst, 3 s body interval with 7 random shots at 3.75–7.5 units/s; base contact/projectile damage 10, existing hostile multiplier remains.
adaptations.arena: Standard Broken Quarry boss pool, weight 2, two suppliers on opposite open sides, atomic spawn preflight; no ordinary/tutorial/Mine additions. Native and Peep bosses remain.
adaptations.completion: One aggregate boss reward; projectiles owned by original segments cancelled at aggregate death. Offspring must also die for clear. Inactive room pauses full chain state.
adaptations.presentation: Original style, procedural faceted stone armor and exposed flesh, no imported Isaac art.

unknowns: Exact native turn/shot/burst timing, size conversion, explosive falloff curve and armor spillover.
Exact short-fragment split/promotion edge cases; current reattachment is an explicit local policy.
Named item-created rock waves/Terra and per-item instant-kill exceptions are not implemented.
Starting-kit survival/difficulty and broader visual/performance acceptance remain open.

61.0.0.movement: Slow flying pursuit toward player, traversing low obstacles and water with room-bound flight collision.
61.0.0.targeting: Pursues the player; death-shot directions fixed rather than aimed.
61.0.0.attacks: Contact while alive; four cardinal damaging shots at death.
61.0.0.vulnerability: Ordinary damageable flyer, source HP 10. Repentance Skatole suppresses contact only, leaving death attacks active.
61.0.0.phases: Alive pursuit then one death burst; no regeneration.
61.0.0.completion: Ordinary room threat while alive; projectiles and creep do not count as enemies.

adaptations.attacks: Local shot speed 8 and base damage 10; current hostile damage conversion remains. Fixed four-way angles are source-backed.
adaptations.creep: Ink uses zero-damage Tar hazard, radius 2, lifetime 4 s, slows current player movement from 6 to 3.2 units/s with 0.3 s refresh; dimensions/duration local. Sucker has none.
adaptations.routing: Actual Tuff offspring in standard Broken Quarry; independent ordinary pools remain pending stage approval. Existing Mine roster identities unchanged.

unknowns: Exact native motion and shot speed, collision conversion and creep timing.
Skatole/item immunity and champion-specific semantics not implemented.
Independent floor routes and full six-gate acceptance remain pending.
